en.content:
Adding “Old iPhone 1x standard lens” to the prompt can significantly improve realism / the feel of a real shoot.  
When using Seedance 2.5 to recreate the popular Korean Girl Vlog style, explicitly write “Early-2000s consumer DV camcorder aesthetic” and add details like heavy handheld shake, autofocus hunting, lens breathing, exposure pumping, rolling shutter, digital compression artifacts, sensor noise, no stabilization, no cinematic camera moves, and no modern color grading to lock in that DV handheld documentary look.  
Use storyboard-style prompts (3 seconds per segment) to describe actions and camera behavior step by step — such as following the subject, drifting off composition, focus jumping back and forth, lighting flickering, sudden cuts to black — to get a rhythm and imperfections that feel more like a real vlog.  
In the prompt, clearly specify “Maintain consistent identity, clothing, hairstyle, and appearance throughout the entire video” to improve consistency in the character’s identity, outfit, and hairstyle.  
Specify “Audio: Natural ambient sound only” and list concrete environmental sounds (birds chirping, motorcycles in the distance, wind, rustling leaves, footsteps, cats meowing, etc.), while also emphasizing “No music / No narration” to achieve a more natural everyday audio atmosphere.

차분한 늦은 아침의 실제 한국 주거 지역. 좁은 콘크리트 골목, 낮은 주택들, 작은 테라스, 화분, 빨랫줄, 자전거, 전봇대, 머리 위 전선, 움직이는 그림자를 드리우는 성숙한 나무들, 조용한 주거 분위기. 상점, 광고, 카페, 군중, 상업 활동 없음.

초실사 다큐멘터리 리얼리즘. 진짜 같은 자연스러운 행동. 자연스러운 바디랭귀지. 각본 없는 일상 스냅샷 같은 느낌. 강한 환경적 사실성. 풍부한 현실 디테일과 믿을 수 있는 인간의 움직임.

Camera Style: 
Early-2000s consumer DV camcorder aesthetic. 친구가 일상 순간을 무심하게 촬영하는 느낌. 강한 핸드헬드 흔들림, 불완전한 구도, 잦은 autofocus hunting, 빛과 그늘 사이를 이동할 때의 exposure pumping, 가끔 보이는 motion blur, 미세한 rolling shutter, 약한 digital compression artifacts, 바랜 색감, 부드러운 대비, 약간의 sensor noise. 3s
작은 집 입구 바깥. 그녀가 낮은 콘크리트 벽에 앉아 두 손을 들어 포니테일을 정리한다. 가벼운 바람이 잔머리를 흔든다. 카메라는 초점을 잡으려 애쓰는 동안 그녀는 자연스럽게 미소 짓는다.

3s
카메라가 화분과 콘크리트 벽이 늘어선 좁은 골목으로 그녀를 따라간다. 그녀는 다가오는 길고양이를 발견하고 쪼그려 앉는다. 촬영자가 따라가려 애쓰는 동안 프레이밍이 중앙에서 벗어난다.

3s
그녀가 고양이를 부드럽게 쓰다듬고 먹이를 준다. autofocus가 그녀의 얼굴과 동물 사이를 반복해서 오간다. 아침 햇살이 머리 위 나뭇잎 사이로 깜빡이며 비친다.

3s
집 옆의 작은 앞마당. 그녀가 빨랫줄에 빨래를 널고, 천은 바람에 흔들린다. 구름이 잠시 머리 위를 지나가며 노출이 변한다.

3s
도자기 커피컵이 놓인 조용한 테라스. 그녀는 편안하게 앉아 동네를 바라보며, 가끔 머리카락을 귀 뒤로 넘긴다. 자연스러운 카메라 드리프트가 있는 느슨한 핸드헬드 측면 앵글.

3s
가까운 측면 프로필. 화면 밖 누군가가 그녀에게 인사한다. 그녀는 돌아서서 손을 들어 올리고, 따뜻하게 미소 지으며, 무심하게 “Annyeong.”이라고 말한다. 카메라는 그 순간을 약간 늦게 포착한다.

3s
나무가 늘어선 주거 골목을 커피컵을 들고 천천히 걷는다. 그녀는 카메라를 알아차리고 작게 진심 어린 미소를 지은 뒤 시선을 돌려 계속 걷는다. 녹화는 캠코더가 꺼진 듯 움직임 중간에 갑자기 검은 화면으로 전환된다.

Goal: 2000년대 초반에 찍힌 잊힌 홈비디오처럼 담긴 진짜 한국 동네의 삶 — 자연스럽고, 불완전하며, 현실적이고, 따뜻하고, 깊이 믿을 수 있게.

[Thread 1] Main subject: 
young Korean woman, early 20s, natural everyday appearance, faded charcoal-grey sleeveless crop top, loose high-waisted light-wash jeans, black canvas sneakers, black cord necklace, black wavy hair in a messy side ponytail with wispy bangs. Realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, warm and approachable personality. Maintain consistent identity, clothing, hairstyle, and appearance throughout the entire video.

Location: 
Authentic Korean residential neighborhood during a calm late morning. Narrow concrete alleys, low-rise homes, small terraces, potted plants, laundry lines, bicycles, utility poles, overhead wires, mature trees casting moving shadows, quiet residential atmosphere. No stores, advertisements, cafés, crowds, or commercial activity.

Visual Style: 
Ultra-realistic documentary realism. Genuine candid behavior. Natural body language. Unscripted slice-of-life feeling. Strong environmental authenticity. Rich real-world details and believable human motion.

Camera Style: 
Early-2000s consumer DV camcorder aesthetic. Friend casually recording everyday moments. Heavy handheld shake, imperfect framing, frequent autofocus hunting, lens breathing, exposure pumping when moving between sun and shade, occasional motion blur, subtle rolling shutter, mild digital compression artifacts, faded colors, soft contrast, slight sensor noise. No stabilization. No cinematic camera moves. No modern color grading.

3s
Outside a small house entrance. She sits on a low concrete wall adjusting her ponytail with both hands raised. A light breeze moves loose strands of hair. She smiles naturally while the camera struggles to hold focus.

3s
The camera follows her into a narrow alley lined with potted plants and concrete walls. She notices a stray cat approaching and crouches down. Framing drifts off-center as the operator tries to keep up.

3s
She gently pets and feeds the cat. Autofocus repeatedly shifts between her face and the animal. Morning sunlight flickers through leaves overhead.

3s
Small front yard beside her house. She hangs laundry on a clothesline while fabrics sway in the breeze. Exposure changes as clouds briefly pass overhead.

3s
On a quiet terrace with a ceramic coffee cup. She sits comfortably watching the neighborhood, occasionally brushing hair behind her ear. Loose handheld side angle with natural camera drift.

3s
Close side profile. Someone off-camera greets her. She turns, raises her hand, smiles warmly, and casually says, “Annyeong.” The camera catches the moment slightly late.

3s
Walking slowly down a tree-lined residential lane holding her coffee cup. She notices the camera, gives a small genuine smile, then looks away and continues walking. Recording cuts abruptly to black mid-motion as if the camcorder was switched off.

Audio: Natural ambient sound only — morning birds, distant motorcycles, light wind, leaves rustling, faint neighborhood chatter, cat sounds, footsteps on concrete, fabric moving on clotheslines, subtle residential ambience. No music. No sound design. No narration.

Goal: Authentic Korean neighborhood life captured like a forgotten home video from the early 2000s — candid, imperfect, realistic, warm, and deeply believable.
